text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Bram, Dell, Greta, Jonah, Pia, Leon, Cora, Mira, Suri, Nils, Una, Vik, Teo, Hugo, Rafe, Wren, Kira, Ines, Ada, Opal, Finn, Esme. Finn out; Wren covering.
Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, garden studio, harbour room are slow. East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, north office, library annex too cold. East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, print room, library annex being repainted (noise). Umbrellas in loading bay, garden studio, north office.
Order items: 515 crates; 400 ladders.
Notes: Finn, Mira, Teo, Suri want north office/loading bay/garden studio clear for visitors. Ines, Leon prefer east wing for reviews. Bram, Kira prefer loading bay. Teo, Ada prefer garden studio. Wren prefers north office. Opal asked if print room free morning; prefers loading bay/harbour room. Bram prefers library annex. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, loading bay working. North office coffee machine working again. Morning stand-up moved to garden studio. Afternoon stand-up moved to print room. Print room being repainted (noise). User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, Kira morning meeting notes; Jonah afternoon notes. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Check with Kira/Hugo before morning meeting; Leon before afternoon meeting. Rafe prefers print room for reviews. East wing repainting causes morning noise. User must send Hugo morning meeting notes. North office lift is slow today. User must send Cora evening meeting notes. Una prefers harbour room for reviews. Dell prefers harbour room for reviews. User must send Kira evening meeting notes. Nils wants north office kept clear for visitors. Hugo wants library annex kept clear for visitors. Leon wants harbour room kept clear for visitors. Rafe asked if north office is free in afternoon. Reminder: Ines prefers print room for reviews. Library annex being repainted (noise morning/evening). User needs to send Opal afternoon meeting notes. Reminder: Mira prefers garden studio for reviews. Reminder: Ada prefers harbour room for reviews. Rafe thinks north office too cold in evening.
